Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): found this generic row sits within a very large multi building campus area with no distinguishing name to narrow the candidates and declined to guess, flagged for future resolution.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, recorded simply as Digital Realty in Fairfax County, VA, could not be confidently matched to a specific building this session. Its coordinates sit near the Fairfax and Loudoun County boundary close to this operators large Ashburn and Loudoun County campus, which spans dozens of separately coded buildings across several streets, Devin Shafron Drive, Digital Loudoun Plaza, Round Table Plaza, Hastings Drive, Chillum Place, Sir Timothy Drive, and Prentice Drive among them. This rows own name carries no building code to narrow the field, and this session could not confidently place it at one specific address among the many campus buildings without a precise geocoding tool. No specific address is asserted for this row.
